resolution: Confirmed the user's inset command syntax and arguments were correct. A reversible live probe proved standalone exact transforms and the full compound recipe both work; the failure was the initial hairline extrusion because no authored face was actively selected. Replaced the generic rollback response with a structured stage-specific error for validation, extrude, either axis scale, or offset, and added a regression test. Restored the disposable live cube after each probe; no model asset was committed.
